finalText:
I worked through all 16 open RMAs. I closed 12, left three open and put one under investigation. Every amount below is in cents. The system date is 2026-07-25, which conflicts with the date in your brief (2026-10-12). I used the system date, since the return window and policy update dates depend on it.

**Closed, with refund and restock**
- **RMA-801:** 10,965 to card, which is 12,900 less the 15% fee. P-KEY went back to sellable.
- **RMA-802:** 15,900 to card with no fee, because PU-21 covers a request made on 07-14. P-HDP went back to sellable.
- **RMA-803:** 27,965 as store credit, which is 32,900 less the 15% fee. It is recorded on the order and added to the customer balance. The line shipped 41 days before the request. The customer only became gold on 07-15, after the request, so PU-18's 45-day window doesn't apply. P-MON went back to sellable.
- **RMA-804:** 27,965 as store credit, which is 32,900 less the 15% fee. It is recorded on the order and added to the customer balance. The line shipped 41 days before the request and the customer is standard tier. P-MON went back to sellable.
- **RMA-805:** 5,520 to card, which is 6,900 less a 20% fee. The request was made on 06-25, inside PU-15. P-HUB went back to sellable.
- **RMA-806:** 7,350 to card with no fee (defective), which is the amount paid after the discount. The 2 mice went to the damaged bucket.
- **RMA-810:** 9,900 to card, which is 12,900 paid less the 3,000 already refunded. The keyboard went to the damaged bucket.
- **RMA-811:** 4,900 to card with no fee (damaged in transit). The mouse went back to sellable, as the warehouse graded it resellable.
- **RMA-812:** 21,900 to card with no fee (defective). The dock went to the damaged bucket.
- **RMA-813:** 10,965 to card, which is 12,900 less the 15% fee. The line shipped exactly 30 days before the request, so it is inside the window. P-KEY went back to sellable.
- **RMA-814:** 31,800 to card with no fee under PU-21. Both units were received, so 2 × P-HDP went back to sellable.
- **RMA-815:** 10,965 to card, which is 12,900 less the 15% fee. The request was 38 days after shipping, but the customer was platinum, so PU-18's 45-day window applies. PU-21 had not started on 07-09, so the fee stands. P-KEY went back to sellable.

**Partly settled, left open**
- **RMA-809:** Two of the three cables have arrived. I refunded 3,800 to card with no fee under PU-21. One cable went back to sellable and one to the damaged bucket. The RMA stays open for the third.

**Not settled**
- **RMA-807:** The warehouse has received nothing against it, whatever the customer's tracking says. I refunded and restocked nothing, and the RMA stays open.
- **RMA-816:** Same situation. Nothing has been received, so it stays open.
- **RMA-808:** The warehouse received a P-CAB against a return for P-MON. I refunded and restocked nothing and opened investigation INV-1.

I did not reply to any customer messages or send customer notices.
